title: IEADPE Flutter + Supabase Free
global_constraints: Flutter web and Android; app UI is pt-BR; communication, comments and artifacts are English.
Supabase Free only; no billing activation, paid add-ons or mandatory Edge Functions.
Google OAuth is the baseline login; email/password and SMS are deferred.
Every SDD role uses gpt-6.1-sol with low reasoning effort; no automatic escalation.
PostgreSQL RLS and authorized transactional RPCs enforce access and business invariants.
Preserve all 101 captured source files unchanged; use synthetic local development data.
Production deployment, live access grants and private-record migration are separate release actions.

Standard Superpowers SDD uses native Codex subagents, TDD, independent task review and a broad final review. Every role is gpt-6.1-sol with low reasoning effort. Use normal workspace tools and direct project checks; do not invoke or repair the custom two-model pipeline. Preserve the captured source and existing unrelated work.

End-user error states use plain pt-BR and a useful next action. Do not expose raw SQL, stack traces, provider internals or environment-variable setup instructions in ordinary user screens; keep technical setup in operations documentation.

tasks.title: Bootstrap the local application
tasks.summary: The deterministic Flutter scaffold, dependency lock and Git repository are already prepared. Implement the localized App and Configuration with a recoverable missing-backend screen, plus the local check script and Supabase config. Do not recreate platform scaffolds or change the locked dependency set.
acceptance: Empty app starts with pt-BR locale; missing backend configuration shows a recoverable setup screen, never a production fallback.

produces: App() -> Widget; Configuration.fromEnvironment() -> Configuration. Read dart-defines SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY; missing values show pt-BR setup guidance and never contact a fallback backend.

tasks.title: Domain models and business calendar
tasks.summary: Define immutable DTO/domain types, date-only codecs, source enum mappings and pure lifecycle predicates. Define Page<T>(items,nextCursor), AccessScope and MutationResult.
acceptance: Assert due boundaries 1/7/30 days, completion 89/90 days, deviation 2/3 visits, missing start, age zero, all 64 source worship values and Sunday 19:59/20:00 in Sao Paulo. Completion is rejected when discipleship is inactive, even with an old known start date.

produces: BusinessCalendar.today(DateTime instant) -> DateOnly; visitState(ConvertRecord, DateOnly) -> VisitState.
consumes: Predecessor interfaces in the human-readable plan; inspect existing callers before edits.

tasks.title: Schema, verified identity and RLS
tasks.summary: Create schema, indexes, profiles trigger, private helpers, default-deny policies, fixed search_path and restricted execution. Add access-version locking, trusted pending-email binding and admin bootstrap instructions. Implement native PostgreSQL test profile per spec, exposing real SQL assertions through Dart test wrappers. The PostgreSQL binaries are supervisor-provided by IEADPE_PG_BIN; do not install dependencies inside a worker.
acceptance: Anonymous reads denied; registrar cannot enumerate converts; direction cannot cross congregation; supervision global; editable metadata cannot grant admin; unverified email cannot bind a pending grant; revoked access denies the next read.

produces: ieadpe_save_access(operation_id uuid,payload jsonb) -> jsonb; ieadpe_revoke_access(operation_id uuid,payload jsonb) -> jsonb; private.can_access_congregation(uuid) -> boolean.
consumes: Predecessor interfaces in the human-readable plan; inspect existing callers before edits.

verification.notes: Dart database tests must execute the SQL scenarios against real loopback PostgreSQL; SQL text matching or mocked authorization is not sufficient.
